answer: A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The pigment multiplier is published, charged in falcon, and bridge lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 2 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 2805 identities would post 2832 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
